name: S-parameters (VNA)
description: Sweeps a vector network analyzer and records the S-parameters (complex traces over frequency), once or repeatedly.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer (calibrate it first for the sweep you use)

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good unit of the same kind): name (in the golden/ folder of the project) or run (a run file), and tolerances = {rows: {match: [columns that pair the rows], columns: {column: tolerance}}, curves, min_overlap}

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points, scale (linear|log), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm (a file written before, with these keys at the top, is read too)

interval_s.description: time between the starts of two sweeps (default 0)

averages.description: sweeps averaged into each recorded one (default 1)

confirm_setup.description: ask once, before measuring, whether the VNA is calibrated and the device connected (default true)

require_calibration.description: stop if the VNA says the data, or one of the S-parameters read, are not corrected by the calibration (default: warn)

z0.description: reference impedance of the VNA (the impedance of its calibration), 50 by default; also written in the Touchstone export
